messages:
Cassandra Li: FYI since ~08:22 UTC were seeing onboarding acknowledgements throttled for Private customers. Symptoms: activations queued, retry storms causing longer tail latencies. I pulled 10 affected tenants. Need a short customer status, replay options, and renewal-touch plan. @Ben can you draft a clear note we can send in two waves?

Ben Wolfe: Drafting now  keeping it short and prescriptive.

Ben Wolfe: Hi <Customer> \u2014 were investigating delayed onboarding activations for Private deployments caused by transient rate-limiting in our provisioning path. Weve applied a mitigation to reduce retries and are replaying queued activations; most customers should complete within 12 hours. If youd like an expedited manual replay, reply here or email cs@redwood.com and well prioritize you. We will follow up with an RCA and propose credits if SLA impact thresholds are met.  Ben, Redwood CS

Iris Park: Tone good. Add a line for customers with trials expiring soon: "If your trial expires within 72 hours tell us and well pause expiry while we finish replays." Also include office hours link.

Cassandra Li: Agreed. Also: flag any tenant with activation >48h as renewal-monitor. Ben, can you add CRM flags after send?

Tommy Nguyen: Tech note: root cause = recent backpressure change in our db-writer that tightened insert rate and triggered retry amplification from the provisioner under burst load (merged in rollout-2026-03-20). I pushed a mitigation (grace-window + jittered backoff) and triggered an immediate replay pump. Worker pool scaling increased; expect replicas to stabilize in ~36min.

cs-bot: [action] scale/provisioner-workers by Tommy Nguyen  job=prov-scale-621 status=success replicas 10 -> 28

Ben Wolfe: Sending wave 1 (high-touch tenants) now. Message copy: ```Hi there  we detected delayed activations for your Private deployment due to transient rate-limiting. Weve applied a mitigation and are replaying activations; most should finish within 12 hours. To request an expedited manual replay reply here or email cs@redwood.com. Well follow up with an RCA and any applicable credits.  Ben, Redwood CS```

Iris Park: Ill open office hours at 09:30 UTC for live replay help and prepare a one-question feedback pulse after resolution. Tommy, can you join for traces?

Tommy Nguyen: I can join 09:3010:00 UTC and will bring retry traces + the config diff.

Cassandra Li: Manual replay steps (internal) for CS/Enablement:
```
# manual replay
1) POST https://internal.replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: replay-{ts}-{tenant_id}"
2) watch logs: kubectl -n vpc-{tenant_id} logs -f replay-worker-{pod}
3) verify: SELECT status, response_code, ts FROM webhook.delivery_events WHERE tenant_id={tenant_id} ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
4) if customer systems show duplicates, provide the Idempotency-Key header and advise holding duplicate processing for 10min
```

Ben Wolfe: CRM update: flagging wave 1 tenants with "rate-limit-onboard" and adding renewal-monitor for >48h. Will send wave 2 in 20m after monitoring.

Iris Park: Feedback capture: short survey link in follow-up: "Was the replay/communication satisfactory? Yes/No + optional comment". Ill add to the follow-up and KB.

Tommy Nguyen: Monitoring: relaxing DB writer rate limit thresholds slightly and added an alert to watch request retry amplification. No data corruption expected; replays are idempotent. Backlog drain ETA ~3060min per tenant depending on queue depth.

Cassandra Li: Renewal play: any tenant with activation >36h gets a renewal-owner handoff for personalized outreach; >48h gets marked renewal-monitor. Ill prepare the handoff sheet and timeline.

cs-bot: [notice] replay-jobs queued: tenants=10 job=replay-rate-1767 status=queued

Ben Wolfe: Wave 1 sent. Seeing a couple replies asking to expedite. Kicking manual replays for those now.

Iris Park: Office hours link posted and KB draft live: https://kb.redwood.internal/onboard-rate-limit-playbook (draft).

Tommy Nguyen: Manual replays running; first confirmations show callbacks delivered. Posting sample latency charts to RCA doc later today.

Cassandra Li: Action items recap: Ben send batches + CRM flags (in progress), Iris KB + office hours + feedback capture (in progress), Tommy RCA + telemetry (ETA EOD), Cassandra exec summary + renewal-owner handoff. Add any other items here.
